worldcombat.skill.rockslide.summary: Hurls the rocks underfoot one after another in arcs onto a chosen patch of ground: foes around each landing take a hit, one target eats at most two, and a solid hit may leave them flinched. Scatter style covers wider; focused style hits harder per rock.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.use.1: Pin several clustered foes at once
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.use.2: Fluster foes in a small area
Each rock deals about %1$s damage to foes within %2$s blocks of where it lands; one target takes at most two hits per cast; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
Throws %1$s rocks, scattered over %2$s blocks around the chosen point.
Carries the rock rain onto ground within %1$s blocks, with rocks flying at %2$s blocks/tick.

A solid hit has a %1$s chance to flinch the target for %2$s s: it interrupts an action in progress that can be interrupted, and while flinched the target can start no new move and make no ordinary attack; each target can be flinched at most once per cast.
Each rock that lands turns a small patch of ground around its impact into rubble for %1$s s, after which the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.scatter.on: Scatter style on: more rocks and a larger radius, but each deals about 18% less power and flinches a little less.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.scatter.off: Scatter style off: fewer, tighter rocks, each dealing about 16% more power and flinching more.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.timing: Cast onto ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.growth.0: At level %1$s the rocks rise to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.growth.1: At level %1$s the rocks rise to %2$s power, %3$s rocks, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.preference.s: On: more rocks and wider coverage, but each is lighter and flinches a little less, for sweeping an area. Off: fewer, tighter rocks that hit harder and flinch more.
worldcombat.skill.rockslide.preference.a: The companion considers Rock Slide only while a foe is this close; higher opens at range but gives the target time to step out before the rocks land.
With this on, the companion raises Rock Slide when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, so one volley covers them all; off keeps the normal attack order.
